newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel names official for Mideast development bank.
newsitem.headline: Israel names official for Mideast development bank.

text.p: The Bank of Israel said on Wednesday it had appointed Danny Yariv to represent Israel on the multinational transitional team launching the Middle East and North Africa development bank.
Yariv, deputy director of the central bank's monetary department, will replace Avner Halevi, who has been named deputy manager of the currency department.
The transitional team, headed by the retired U.S. ambassador David Dunford, is in charge of launching the institution, which is expected to open its doors by the end of the year.
Dunford is now visiting Israel to meet with senior Foreign Ministry, Treasury and central bank officials.
The Bank of Israel said that at a meeting with Dunford its governor, Jacob Frenkel, said Israel supported the establishment of the bank as an aid to regional development amd the peace process.
